## ISC Search API — Identities in Engineering Department

Use the `POST /v3/search` endpoint with the `identities` index and a query filtering on the `department` attribute.

### Request

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "attributes.department:\"Engineering\""
  },
  "sort": ["name"],
  "limit": 250
}
```

### Key details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| `indices` | `["identities"]` — targets the identity index |
| `query.query` | Elasticsearch-style query string; `attributes.department` is the field path for standard identity attributes |
| `limit` | Max 250 per page (default); use `searchAfter` for pagination beyond 10,000 results |

### Paginating past 250 results

```json
{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "attributes.department:\"Engineering\""
  },
  "sort": ["name"],
  "limit": 250,
  "searchAfter": ["lastNameFromPreviousPage"]
}
```

Or use `offset` for smaller result sets (offset-based pagination is limited to 10,000 total).

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/search
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:search:read]
key_parameters: [indices, query, sort, limit, searchAfter]
```
